verses.ar: إِذَا جَلَسْتَ تَأْكُلُ مَعَ مُتَسَلِّطٍ، فَتَأَمَّلْ مَا هُوَ أَمَامَكَ تَأَمُّلًا،
verses.kjv: When thou sittest to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what [is] before thee:
verses.web: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

verses.ar: وَضَعْ سِكِّينًا لِحَنْجَرَتِكَ إِنْ كُنْتَ شَرِهًا.
verses.kjv: And put a knife to thy throat, if thou [be] a man given to appetite.
verses.web: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

verses.ar: لَا تَشْتَهِ أَطَايِبَهُ لِأَنَّهَا خُبْزُ أَكَاذِيبَ.
verses.kjv: Be not desirous of his dainties: for they [are] deceitful meat.
verses.web: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

verses.ar: لَا تَتْعَبْ لِكَيْ تَصِيرَ غَنِيًّا. كُفَّ عَنْ فِطْنَتِكَ.
verses.kjv: Labour not to be rich: cease from thine own wisdom.
verses.web: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

verses.ar: هَلْ تُطَيِّرُ عَيْنَيْكَ نَحْوَهُ وَلَيْسَ هُوَ؟ لِأَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا يَصْنَعُ لِنَفْسِهِ أَجْنِحَةً. كَٱلنَّسْرِ يَطِيرُ نَحْوَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ.
verses.kjv: Wilt thou set thine eyes upon that which is not? for [riches] certainly make themselves wings; they fly away as an eagle toward heaven.
verses.web: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

verses.ar: لَا تَأْكُلْ خُبْزَ ذِي عَيْنٍ شِرِّيرَةٍ، وَلَا تَشْتَهِ أَطَايِبَهُ،
verses.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of [him that hath] an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
verses.web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ كَمَا شَعَرَ فِي نَفْسِهِ هَكَذَا هُوَ. يَقُولُ لَكَ: «كُلْ وَٱشْرَبْ» وَقَلْبُهُ لَيْسَ مَعَكَ.
verses.kjv: For as he thinketh in his heart, so [is] he: Eat and drink, saith he to thee; but his heart [is] not with thee.
verses.web: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

verses.ar: ٱللُّقْمَةُ ٱلَّتِي أَكَلْتَهَا تَتَقَيَّأُهَا، وَتَخْسَرُ كَلِمَاتِكَ ٱلْحُلْوَةَ.
verses.kjv: The morsel [which] thou hast eaten shalt thou vomit up, and lose thy sweet words.
verses.web: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

verses.ar: فِي أُذُنَيْ جَاهِلٍ لَا تَتَكَلَّمْ لِأَنَّهُ يَحْتَقِرُ حِكْمَةَ كَلَامِكَ.
verses.kjv: Speak not in the ears of a fool: for he will despise the wisdom of thy words.
verses.web: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

verses.ar: لَا تَنْقُلِ ٱلتُّخُمَ ٱلْقَدِيمَ، وَلَا تَدْخُلْ حُقُولَ ٱلْأَيْتَامِ،
verses.kjv: Remove not the old landmark; and enter not into the fields of the fatherless:
verses.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ وَلِيَّهُمْ قَوِيٌّ. هُوَ يُقِيمُ دَعْوَاهُمْ عَلَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: For their redeemer [is] mighty; he shall plead their cause with thee.
verses.web: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

verses.ar: وَجِّهْ قَلْبَكَ إِلَى ٱلْأَدَبِ، وَأُذُنَيْكَ إِلَى كَلِمَاتِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةِ.
verses.kjv: Apply thine heart unto instruction, and thine ears to the words of knowledge.
verses.web: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

verses.ar: لَا تَمْنَعِ ٱلتَّأْدِيبَ عَنِ ٱلْوَلَدِ، لِأَنَّكَ إِنْ ضَرَبْتَهُ بِعَصًا لَا يَمُوتُ.
verses.kjv: Withhold not correction from the child: for [if] thou beatest him with the rod, he shall not die.
verses.web: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

verses.ar: تَضْرِبُهُ أَنْتَ بِعَصًا فَتُنْقِذُ نَفْسَهُ مِنَ ٱلْهَاوِيَةِ.
verses.kjv: Thou shalt beat him with the rod, and shalt deliver his soul from hell.
verses.web: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، إِنْ كَانَ قَلْبُكَ حَكِيمًا يَفْرَحُ قَلْبِي أَنَا أَيْضًا،
verses.kjv: My son, if thine heart be wise, my heart shall rejoice, even mine.
verses.web: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

verses.ar: وَتَبْتَهِجُ كِلْيَتَايَ إِذَا تَكَلَّمَتْ شَفَتَاكَ بِٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَاتِ.
verses.kjv: Yea, my reins shall rejoice, when thy lips speak right things.
verses.web: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

verses.ar: لَا يَحْسِدَنَّ قَلْبُكَ ٱلْخَاطِئِينَ، بَلْ كُنْ فِي مَخَافَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ ٱلْيَوْمَ كُلَّهُ.
verses.kjv: Let not thine heart envy sinners: but [be thou] in the fear of the LORD all the day long.
verses.web: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear Yahweh all day long.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ لَا بُدَّ مِنْ ثَوَابٍ، وَرَجَاؤُكَ لَا يَخِيبُ.
verses.kjv: For surely there is an end; and thine expectation shall not be cut off.
verses.web: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعْ أَنْتَ يَا ٱبْنِي، وَكُنْ حَكِيمًا، وَأَرْشِدْ قَلْبَكَ فِي ٱلطَّرِيقِ.
verses.kjv: Hear thou, my son, and be wise, and guide thine heart in the way.
verses.web: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

verses.ar: لَا تَكُنْ بَيْنَ شِرِّيبِي ٱلْخَمْرِ، بَيْنَ ٱلْمُتْلِفِينَ أَجْسَادَهُمْ،
verses.kjv: Be not among winebibbers; among riotous eaters of flesh:
verses.web: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلسِّكِّيرَ وَٱلْمُسْرِفَ يَفْتَقِرَانِ، وَٱلنَّوْمُ يَكْسُو ٱلْخِرَقَ.
verses.kjv: For the drunkard and the glutton shall come to poverty: and drowsiness shall clothe [a man] with rags.
verses.web: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

verses.ar: اِسْمَعْ لِأَبِيكَ ٱلَّذِي وَلَدَكَ، وَلَا تَحْتَقِرْ أُمَّكَ إِذَا شَاخَتْ.
verses.kjv: Hearken unto thy father that begat thee, and despise not thy mother when she is old.
verses.web: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

verses.ar: اِقْتَنِ ٱلْحَقَّ وَلَا تَبِعْهُ، وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلْأَدَبَ وَٱلْفَهْمَ.
verses.kjv: Buy the truth, and sell [it] not; [also] wisdom, and instruction, and understanding.
verses.web: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

verses.ar: أَبُو ٱلصِّدِّيقِ يَبْتَهِجُ ٱبْتِهَاجًا، وَمَنْ وَلَدَ حَكِيمًا يُسَرُّ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: The father of the righteous shall greatly rejoice: and he that begetteth a wise [child] shall have joy of him.
verses.web: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

verses.ar: يَفْرَحُ أَبُوكَ وَأُمُّكَ، وَتَبْتَهِجُ ٱلَّتِي وَلَدَتْكَ.
verses.kjv: Thy father and thy mother shall be glad, and she that bare thee shall rejoice.
verses.web: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي أَعْطِنِي قَلْبَكَ، وَلْتُلَاحِظْ عَيْنَاكَ طُرُقِي.
verses.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
verses.web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلزَّانِيَةَ هُوَّةٌ عَمِيقَةٌ، وَٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّةُ حُفْرَةٌ ضَيِّقَةٌ.
verses.kjv: For a whore [is] a deep ditch; and a strange woman [is] a narrow pit.
verses.web: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

verses.ar: هِيَ أَيْضًا كَلِصٍّ تَكْمُنُ وَتَزِيدُ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.kjv: She also lieth in wait as [for] a prey, and increaseth the transgressors among men.
verses.web: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

verses.ar: لِمَنِ ٱلْوَيْلُ؟ لِمَنِ ٱلشَّقَاوَةُ؟ لِمَنِ ٱلْمُخَاصَمَاتُ؟ لِمَنِ ٱلْكَرْبُ؟ لِمَنِ ٱلْجُرُوحُ بِلَا سَبَبٍ؟ لِمَنِ ٱزْمِهْرَارُ ٱلْعَيْنَيْنِ؟
verses.kjv: Who hath woe? who hath sorrow? who hath contentions? who hath babbling? who hath wounds without cause? who hath redness of eyes?
verses.web: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

verses.ar: لِلَّذِينَ يُدْمِنُونَ ٱلْخَمْرَ، ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِي طَلَبِ ٱلشَّرَابِ ٱلْمَمْزُوجِ.
verses.kjv: They that tarry long at the wine; they that go to seek mixed wine.
verses.web: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

verses.ar: لَا تَنْظُرْ إِلَى ٱلْخَمْرِ إِذَا ٱحْمَرَّتْ حِينَ تُظْهِرُ حِبَابَهَا فِي ٱلْكَأْسِ وَسَاغَتْ مُرَقْرِقَةً.
verses.kjv: Look not thou upon the wine when it is red, when it giveth his colour in the cup, [when] it moveth itself aright.
verses.web: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

verses.ar: فِي ٱلْآخِرِ تَلْسَعُ كَٱلْحَيَّةِ وَتَلْدَغُ كَٱلْأُفْعُوانِ.
verses.kjv: At the last it biteth like a serpent, and stingeth like an adder.
verses.web: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

verses.ar: عَيْنَاكَ تَنْظُرَانِ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّاتِ، وَقَلْبُكَ يَنْطِقُ بِأُمُورٍ مُلْتَوِيَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Thine eyes shall behold strange women, and thine heart shall utter perverse things.
verses.web: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ كَمُضْطَجعٍ فِي قَلْبِ ٱلْبَحْرِ، أَوْ كَمُضْطَجعٍ عَلَى رَأْسِ سَارِيَةٍ.
verses.kjv: Yea, thou shalt be as he that lieth down in the midst of the sea, or as he that lieth upon the top of a mast.
verses.web: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

verses.ar: يَقُولُ: «ضَرَبُونِي وَلَمْ أَتَوَجَّعْ! لَقَدْ لَكَأُونِي وَلَمْ أَعْرِفْ! مَتَى أَسْتَيْقِظُ؟ أَعُودُ أَطْلُبُهَا بَعْدُ!».
verses.kjv: They have stricken me, [shalt thou say, and] I was not sick; they have beaten me, [and] I felt [it] not: when shall I awake? I will seek it yet again.
verses.web: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”
